street.consensusNote: Ten of thirteen are Buy/Outperform. Every house that discloses a method uses EV/EBITDA on FY28E (or Jun-28E), 23-30x, three as a SOTP that deducts minorities and adds Oriental Hotels and 51% of TajSATS separately. Post-Q1 targets Rs783-925. None of the notes we saw adjusts the multiple for the 2026 sector de-rating; most kept or raised multiples after Q1.

moat.brand: Taj rated India's strongest brand five years running (Brand Finance); value ~$900 m
moat.scale: Largest network in India (382 operating, 263 pipeline)
moat.assets: Irreplaceable owned palaces and city-centre hotels (Taj Mahal Palace, Lake Palace, Rambagh)
moat.weakness: Hotel rooms are a commodity outside the luxury tier; Ginger competes with Lemon Tree, Treebo, OYO and Marriott/Hilton/IHG select-service brands

critiques: Revenue growth leans on acquisitions and leases (4-5 points of the 12-14% guide); like-for-like growth is 7-9%
Margins at the consolidated level are capped near 33-35% by TajSATS (~20-24%) and leased hotels (license fees)
Minorities rose to ~8% of profit with TajSATS, ANK/Pride, Atmantan and Brij (each 49% outside)
The stock sat at ~24x one-year-forward EV/EBITDA on 30-Sep-2026 while listed hotel peers had de-rated 26-41% versus their five-year medians
gaps: Hotel segment split between owned/leased and managed is not disclosed; management fees are reported but their margin is not (we assume ~80%)
Q2FY25-Q3FY25 segment split (TajSATS consolidated from Aug-2024) not taken from a filing; left blank
Lease additions for Frankfurt (Jun-2026) and the Jun-2026 balance sheet were not published by 30-Sep-2026 (half-year balance sheet came in October); FY27E lease additions are our estimate
TajSATS stand-alone net cash and debt not separated from group cash; its 49% share of cash is not deducted (small)
No third-party consensus dated close to 30-Sep-2026; we compiled 13 notes
Brokers' EBITDA definitions differ (some include other income); not all estimates are on the same basis
OHL merger: share issue (~2.32 cr) is not in our share count; shown as a sensitivity
conflicts: Revenue: company 'total revenue' (Rs9,971 cr FY26) includes Rs282 cr of other income; we use operating revenue (Rs9,689 cr) and operating EBITDA (Rs3,195 cr) as Screener does
Exceptional items: Screener shows Rs309 cr for FY26 versus the company's Rs276 cr pre-tax (Rs236 cr after tax); Screener's other income (Rs557 cr) includes them
Elara's 25-Jul-2026 target is reported as Rs732 in one roundup, equal to the share price; we use the 12-May-2026 Rs716
